changes.summary: Advanced the immutable target to NVIDIA's current ff433f54 model-card revision.
changes.details: The only upstream change is a 234-byte README addition linking NVIDIA's public summary of training content. Weights, runtime code, tokenizer, parser, vLLM 0.27.1 launch, and MTPv2 companion are byte-identical, so existing deployments need no rebuild or restart.

changes.summary: Routed non-root vLLM caches to the writable outputs mount.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Followed NVIDIA's revised DGX Spark contract by moving to immutable vLLM 0.27.1 and adding the separately released MTPv2 speculative-decoding head.
changes.details: The target advances to 445d56f3; its weights, code, tokenizer, and super_v3 parser are unchanged from 4f0cf9da, while the updated model card changes the Spark runtime and recommends MTPv2. The exact 5.88 GB companion is now hydrated into /models/drafter, so offline startup performs no hidden Hugging Face download.

changes.summary: Made the Super recipe executable with NVIDIA's immutable vLLM 0.20.0 ARM64 image and snapshot-owned super_v3 parser plugin.
changes.details: The reviewed launch now includes explicit FP4/Marlin execution, FP8 KV cache, Mamba cache settings, and MTP speculative decoding with no startup download.

changes.summary: Applied FP8 KV, Mamba cache, and MTP settings and recorded the unsupported super_v3 parser and explicit FP4/Marlin requirements.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
